chunks: And he, peace be upon him, said:
"Everything has a means of purification, and the purification of the mouth is the siwak."

key_terms.السِّوَاكُ: the tooth-cleaning stick used to clean the mouth and teeth
key_terms.طَهُورٌ: a means of purification or cleansing

ai.seo_question: What does Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام say about siwak and the purification of the mouth?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches that every thing has a means of taharah (ritual purity/cleanliness), and for the mouth that means is the siwak. It highlights the importance of oral cleanliness as part of refined Islamic practice and personal hygiene.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications:
Hadith.116 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said:
"Everything has a means of purification, and the means of purification for the mouth is the siwak (tooth cleaning)."
